title: Stay True Amendments
description: Reverts some texture changes in Stay True to retain more of a vanilla feel.
body: Requires Stay True as a dependency. Reverts some of the texture changes in Stay True. The texture changes include reverting TNT and TNT Minecarts to their original red textures and removes bushy leaves. Stay True Amendment has some other mod and texture pack support. Brickier Fuel Quarry's textures will match the bricks from Stay True with this texture pack.   Make sure this texture pack is loaded above Stay True in the resource pack load order. It is an addon to Stay True, it does not replace it.   Although made for the Concatenation modpacks, feel free to use in any modpack.
